title: A finite-element-inspired bipartite graph learned simulator for manufacturability assessment in large-deformation sheet forming
abstract: arXiv:2605.22845v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Explicit dynamic finite element (FE) simulations are widely used for large-deformation analysis but remain expensive for design-space exploration. In explicit FE analysis, nodal kinematics and element-level deformation measures evolve through a coupled node-element update process. An FE-inspired learned simulator can preserve this structure and learn nodal kinematics and elemental deformation on their native domains. Nodal displacement describes geometry evolution, while elemental thinning identifies local deformation and critical regions. Feeding both outputs back during rollout allows each field to inform subsequent updates of the other. This work proposes CAtt-BiGNN, a cross-attention-based bipartite graph neural network for coupled nodal-elemental learning. translated_title: 一种受有限元启发的二部图学习模拟器，用于大变形板料成形的可制造性评估
translated_abstract: 显式动力学有限元（FE）模拟被广泛应用于大变形分析，但对于设计空间探索而言成本仍然高昂。在显式有限元分析中，节点运动学和单元级变形量通过耦合的节点-单元更新过程不断演化。受有限元启发的学习模拟器可以保留这一结构，并在各自的原生域上学习节点运动学和单元变形。节点位移描述几何演化，而单元减薄率识别局部变形和关键区域。在滚动预测过程中将两种输出同时反馈，使每个场能够为另一个场的后续更新提供信息。本工作提出了CAtt-BiGNN，一种基于交叉注意力的二部图神经网络，用于节点-单元耦合学习。该二部图编码了有限元引导的状态组织和信息流，而无需施加平衡或本构约束。网格节点和单元被表示……
tldr: 该论文提出CAtt-BiGNN，一种基于交叉注意力的二部图神经网络，通过模拟显式有限元中节点运动学与单元变形的耦合更新机制，实现大变形板料成形可制造性的高效评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CAtt-BiGNN, a cross-attention-based bipartite graph neural network that mimics the coupled node-element update process of explicit finite element analysis, enabling efficient manufacturability assessment for large-deformation sheet forming.
